declarations.name: evenRemotePairGauge_eq_remotePairGauge
declarations.doc: The even gauge is the general gauge at the doubled quartet family.** Hence the even case is an instance of the general index arithmetic, and the exact index rises by `2` per quartet.

declarations.name: isWassersteinPoint_of_commute
declarations.doc: Proposition 6.1(1) (Kim–Mer–Pálfia): consistency with scalars.** For a commuting family the square of the weighted arithmetic mean of the square roots is a Wasserstein point. The normalisation `∑ wᵢ = 1` is not needed.

declarations.name: isFinitelyPresented_specialLinearGroup_of_numberFieldArchimedeanPositiveFiniteCusps
declarations.doc: Finite-cusp presentation criterion on the established positive-form interface.** The correct raw-cone topology is discharged internally, so callers supply only arithmetic cusp data.

declarations.name: pointedCutoffWardTrace_neg_tangent
declarations.doc: Orientation law.** The signed Ward trace is odd in the source tangent, in contrast to the quadratic Hilbert--Schmidt energy. Hence this scalarization retains rather than squares away the orientation carried by an arithmetic tangent.

declarations.name: primeValuationMeasure_range_natValuationVector
declarations.doc: The integers are null in the sector.** Every natural number has finitely many prime divisors, so the arithmetic points carry no mass: the product model of a random integer is supported away from the integers.

declarations.name: exists_scales_componentProjectivelyIndependent
declarations.doc: Rational-transverse component scaling.** Independently scaling any finite family of maximally projective component spectra can make all component gap modules mutually projectively independent. The scales are obtained by countable real-analytic avoidance; no arithmetic independence is assumed.

declarations.name: cross_coherence_forces_collar_mass
declarations.doc: If a total cross interaction exceeds `theta` ridge units while its far part costs at most `delta` ridge units, the intermediate collar carries the remaining coefficient mass. Arithmetic applications separately bound the two displayed component pairings.

declarations.name: TailCoefficientIndependent.exists_fullRank_evaluation_packet
declarations.doc: Finite Jacobian probe.** A tail-independent coefficient family admits a square packet of coordinates whose evaluation matrix is a unit. This is the finite linear-algebra input required by the Shapiro--Sparer arithmetic-function Jacobian criterion.

declarations.name: isFinitelyPresented_specialLinearGroup_of_numberFieldArchimedeanMatrixFiniteCusps
declarations.doc: Finite-cusp reduction on the corrected archimedean cone presents the integral special-linear group. Convexity, nonemptiness, topology, and continuity of the action are discharged here; only the arithmetic reduction data remain.

declarations.name: cofiniteTailDenseOn_homogeneousRelationSystem_eq_iff_constraintHull_eq
declarations.doc: Object reconstruction from the arithmetic tail.** For tail-complete sources, equality of the entire labelled prime-valuation relation system is equivalent to equality of the homogeneous algebraic source hulls.

declarations.name: exists_entire_dilates_jointlyHypertranscendental_countable
declarations.doc: One entire source for a countable dilate family.** For every countable family of distinct nonzero complex dilations — with no arithmetic hypothesis whatsoever — there is an entire function with full Taylor support whose whole dilate family is jointly hypertranscendental.

declarations.name: case32_key
declarations.doc: The arithmetic contradiction of Grynkiewicz's CASE 3.2.** The denominator of the second term of Lemma 2.1, after substituting `k = t − 1` and `#T ≤ #A − #B + t − 1`, is `#A·#B − (#B − t + 1)²`, and the resulting inequality is impossible.

declarations.name: exists_integer_jet_relation_of_differentialAlgebraicOver
declarations.doc: Arithmetic extraction from rational differential algebraicity.** In any characteristic-zero coefficient field `C` sitting between `ℚ` and the ambient differential field, a differentially algebraic element admits a nonzero finite jet relation whose every coefficient is an integer.

declarations.name: thetaTranslationNonresonant_period_of_ne
declarations.doc: A period different from both members of a pair is nonresonant for that pair.** This is the arithmetic input of the cross-face separation: a parameter surviving on one bottom face is external for any face whose surviving pair avoids it.

declarations.name: algebraicIndependent_over_finitePrimeCoefficientField_of_tailIndependent
declarations.doc: Pong's conclusion over `E_fin`.** A finite family of arithmetic functions whose prime values are tail independent is algebraically independent over the finite-prime coefficient field — with no restriction on the support of the functions.

declarations.name: abs_halfLineAutocorrelation_le
declarations.doc: The uniform autocorrelation bound.** By the arithmetic–geometric mean inequality and the fact that a nonnegative integrand over a shifted ray has smaller mass, the autocorrelation is bounded by the source's square mass -- the same constant Cauchy–Schwarz gives, with no `L^p` machinery.

declarations.name: symb_eq_zero_of_carrier_const
declarations.doc: A constant carrier annihilates every symbol along the arithmetic progression `m a`.** Composition with `exp (a ·)` covers the punctured plane, so the dilate combination is constant on all of `ℂ`, and its `m`-th derivative at the origin is the symbol at `m a`.

declarations.name: iteratedDeriv_two_shiftedEulerCoeff
declarations.doc: The two-prime layer.** The second transverse derivative of the shifted Euler coefficient is four times the Dirichlet self-convolution of the von Mangoldt function. Together with `iteratedDeriv_one_shiftedEulerCoeff` this identifies both low tangent layers of the shifted Euler quotient with the classical arithmetic convolutions.

declarations.name: cofiniteTailDenseOn_primePowerShiftedRotatedJet_tailIndependent
declarations.doc: Prime-power valuation dilation and the rotated analytic clock only rescale the columns of the tail-dense shift--jet rectangle by nonzero constants, so the complete separation law survives in the exact coefficient form used by the arithmetic differential carriers.

declarations.name: RootedRealization.strictCorePairObstruction
declarations.doc: `(8.2)` as the card states it: the pair of strict arithmetic obstructions.** Lemma 8.1 gives strict separation of the diagonal from the edge at both endpoints, so a rooted realization forces both integral inequalities, with the same off-diagonal entry on the right by symmetry of the core.

declarations.name: weldClass_two_base_indep_iff
declarations.doc: Rank dichotomy, at the level of weld classes.** The two weld classes `weldClass (log j)` and `weldClass (log k)` are `ℤ`-linearly independent in `H²` exactly when the bases `j, k` are multiplicatively independent. The injective homomorphism transports the elementary arithmetic dichotomy of §4 to the cohomology.

declarations.name: exists_radius_point_norm_mul_logDeriv_sub_centralIndex_le
declarations.doc: The Wiman--Valiron estimate with no side conditions.** The maximum-modulus point of the selected circle exists and supplies every hypothesis the window estimate asks of it, so the statement reduces to the arithmetic conditions on the parameters.

declarations.name: log_one_add_rpow_le
declarations.doc: The `α`-power logarithm bound.** `log(1 + x^α) ≤ log 2 + α·log⁺x`.

declarations.name: exists_entire_dilates_jointlyHypertranscendental
declarations.doc: An entire source whose dilates are jointly hypertranscendental.** For every finite family of distinct nonzero complex dilations — with no arithmetic hypothesis whatsoever — there is an entire function with full Taylor support such that no algebraic differential equation with complex coefficients relates the point to the jets of all the dilates.

declarations.name: two_mul_incidence_le
declarations.doc: The incidence pairing bound.** For a `2`-design and a function of sum zero on the points, the pairing against any function on the lines is bounded by `√(r - lam)` times the sum of the two squared lengths. This is Cauchy--Schwarz against the design identity, followed by the arithmetic mean bound.

declarations.name: tendsto_criticalClockLaplace_of_simplePole
declarations.doc: Critical clock universality.** If the Mellin transform of a nonnegative source has a simple pole at `σ = 1`, then its clock Laplace transform converges to the unit-rate exponential transform `1/(1+u)`. Only the pole is used: no Tauberian theorem, no arithmetic, and no further property of the underlying measure.

declarations.name: tendsto_integral_monotoneCoupling_logClock
declarations.doc: Critical transport for logarithmic clock laws.** If the Dirichlet series of a family of arithmetic weights converges at every natural shift to the Laplace transform of the mean-one exponential law, and the logarithmically weighted means converge to one, then the monotone couplings of the clocks with that law have vanishing transport cost.

declarations.name: cofiniteTailDenseOn_homogeneousRelationSystem_eq_iff_constraintSystem_eq
declarations.doc: Homogeneous constraint reconstruction law.** For tail-dense profiles, equality of the full graded prime-tail relation system is equivalent to equality of the full homogeneous vanishing system of the source constraints. The labelled arithmetic relations therefore recover exactly the reduced homogeneous constraint algebra.

declarations.name: cubic_nonneg_of_quartic
declarations.doc: The main implication.** A single quartic monomial inequality on the raw even moments implies the cubic moment inequality. The proof squares the arithmetic–geometric mean step: with `A = 3m₀m₁m₃` and `B = 15m₁²m₂`, ```text (A + B)² ≥ 4AB = 180 m₀m₁³m₂m₃ ≥ 100 m₀²m₂⁴ = (10 m₀m₂²)² , ``` the middle inequality being the hypothesis multiplied by `20 m₀ m₂`.

declarations.name: gaussBonnet_normalization_incompatible
declarations.doc: Appendix Lemma 10.1, arithmetic core.** The two evaluations of the total curvature of a reducible reduced central fibre are incompatible: the Gauss–Bonnet value `χ(X_s)` and the normalization value `χ(X_s) + defect` cannot agree, because the defect is positive. Hence the standing assumption that the curvature stays bounded below is untenable.

declarations.name: exists_radius_point_window_data
declarations.doc: The selected radius, with its window data.** Under the arithmetic conditions of `exists_radius_norm_mul_logDeriv_sub_centralIndex_le` there is a radius in the sampling interval and a maximum-modulus point of its circle at which the central index is Lipschitz on the window — every hypothesis both Wiman--Valiron window estimates ask for.

declarations.name: exists_gap_sequence_of_cells
declarations.doc: From cell maximisers to an indexed sequence with a uniform gap.** Taking every second cell and continuing by an arithmetic progression past the range gives a sequence whose consecutive terms differ by at least the cell length — the form a large-values estimate consumes, which is stated for an indexed family with a gap at every index.

declarations.name: cofiniteTailDenseOn_primeResidueValuationDisjointFusion_external_not_internal
declarations.doc: External fusion / internal non-generation.** Disjoint source sectors fuse exactly to their union on the arithmetic-function side, but the resulting carrier is not in the differential field generated by the two input carriers. Thus prime-valuation fusion cannot be internalized by any differential-rational expression in its inputs.

declarations.name: gauss_haar_average
declarations.doc: Exact two-variable Haar average** (Gauss-component residue constant). For a prime-power scale `s_p(x) = p^(1-x)`, the product of the `m`-th and `(-m)`-th moment integrals over the unit circle equals the exact arithmetic constant appearing in the critical weak-Schatten residue: `(∫₀¹ s_p^m)(∫₀¹ s_p^{-m}) = (p^m − 1)² / (p^m · m² · (log p)²)`.

declarations.name: pointwise_route_saturates
declarations.doc: Why the pointwise route caps at the pivot.** Even the best conceivable size, the Conrey–Gonek `Δ_k(x,h) ≪ x^{1/2+ε}`, gives `m(k) = 1` only for `k ≤ 4`; beyond that a pointwise bound cannot reach the Lindelöf value, because `x^{2/k}` drops below the square-root barrier `x^{1/2}`. This is the exact arithmetic behind the `(1, 1/2) ↦ 1/8` row of the separation table.

declarations.name: weldClass_indep_of_linIndep
declarations.doc: Abstract independence transport.** For any `ℤ`-linearly-independent family of real rates `r : ι → ℝ`, the weld classes `{weldClass (r i)}` are `ℤ`-linearly independent in `H²`: a finitely-supported integer combination that vanishes has all coefficients zero. The whole content is transported through the injective weld-class homomorphism; the arithmetic of the primes plays no role. `primes_weld_class_indep` is the instance `r = log ∘ (·)` over `Nat.Primes`.

declarations.name: exists_pow_sub_one_mem_of_finite_quotient
declarations.doc: A prime with finite residue field divides `aⁿ − 1` for some `n > 0`, whenever it does not divide `a`.** The residue of `a` is a nonzero element of a finite field, hence a root of unity. This is the arithmetic half of the cyclotomic engine for Milnor symbols: it guarantees that every prime not dividing `a` occurs in the factorisation of some `1 − aⁿ`, and `{a, 1 − aⁿ}` is always `n`-torsion.

declarations.name: exists_arbitrarilyWeak_traceClassDiagonalHamiltonian_saturating
declarations.doc: Universal countable pure-point instability law.** Every countable real spectrum, with no boundedness, simplicity, or arithmetic assumption, admits an arbitrarily small absolutely summable diagonal perturbation whose bounded operator is self-adjoint and Schatten-1, whose perturbed maximal Hamiltonian is self-adjoint on exactly the original domain, and whose spectrum has no nonzero finitely supported projective relation. This is the structure-free form of the law. The preceding separable theorem strengthens it for composite spectra by forcing the perturbation to factor through the two subsystems.

declarations.name: HasScalarDifferentialOrder.algHom_pow
declarations.doc: Exact order grows arithmetically under iterated differential substitution.

declarations.name: abs_sum_sub_integral_le_of_monotoneOn_scaled
declarations.doc: Monotone Riemann-sum error at mesh `1/k`.** For `f` monotone on `[c, c + n/k]` (`n` cells of width `1/k`, `k > 0`), the mid-mesh Riemann sum `(1/k)·∑_{i<n} f(c + i/k)` differs from the integral by at most `(1/k)·(f(c+n/k) - f(c))` — the total rise scaled by the mesh. Reduced to the unit-step bound `abs_sum_sub_integral_le_of_monotoneOn` by the affine substitution `t ↦ c + t/k` (`intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_mul`). This is the quadrature error at the arithmetic mesh `n/k` that a bounded-variation prime-window error `H_W` sums over.

declarations.name: exact_neg_inertia
declarations.doc: Exact Krein–Langer inertia `κ₋ = k`** for the factored Hermitian matrix `H = ∑_i w_i w_i* − ∑_i u_i u_i*`, given the evaluation map `(Φ,Ψ): x ↦ (⟨w_i,x⟩, ⟨u_i,x⟩)` surjective (Cauchy non-degeneracy of `{w_i, u_i}`): the negative inertia is **exactly `k`** — every negative-definite subspace has `dim ≤ k` (upper, via `H + ∑ u_i u_i* = ∑ w_i w_i* ⪰ 0`), and one of `dim = k` exists (lower, `exists_neg_def_subspace`). For the conjugate-pair carrier (`w_i=e_i+a_i`, `u_i=e_i−a_i`) the surjectivity hypothesis is exactly the Cauchy independence of the `2k` pole-vectors `{a_i, e_i}` — the sole remaining arithmetic input for the closed-form `κ₋ = #off-line zeros`.

declarations.name: analyticOrderAt_conicPhysicalPullback_eq_three_of_rankThree
declarations.doc: A rank-three arithmetically independent source can simultaneously lie on the complex Hankel conic and have physical tangency excess one.

declarations.name: divisibility_firewall
declarations.doc: The divisibility firewall.** For every abelian group `A`, every nonzero `ℚ`-vector space `V` and every direct sum `T` of finite groups: the mod-`m` classes, the torsion, and every homomorphism into `T` are the same for `A × V` as for `A`, yet `A × V` is not torsion. Read arithmetically with `A = K_2(𝒪_F)`: no family of statements about the groups `K_2/m`, about the torsion, or about reciprocity maps into direct sums of finite groups — that is, no combination of the Merkurjev–Suslin/Tate isomorphism, Moore's sequence, and finiteness of étale cohomology with finite coefficients — can imply that `K_2(𝒪_F)` is torsion. The essential input of any such proof must be a statement about the integral group that does not factor through its finite-coefficient data.

declarations.doc: Chronological second prefixes converge to the canonical complex second level.

declarations.name: eulerDeletionDevelopmentLimit_eq_one_of_zeta_zero
declarations.doc: At every positive-half-plane zeta zero, every commutative development limit is the unit.

declarations.name: tendsto_coprimeEulerDeletionProduct_prefix_of_zeta_zero
declarations.doc: Every positive-half-plane zeta zero closes every degree-two coprime deletion cylinder.

declarations.name: tendsto_eulerDeletionWeightedJump_prefix_of_zeta_zero
declarations.doc: At a positive-half-plane zeta zero, every weighted deletion prefix tends to zero.

declarations.name: zeta_zero_closes_first_level
declarations.doc: Actual arithmetic zeros close the first level of the same completed word history. No higher-level vanishing follows from this statement.

declarations.name: tendsto_continuedSource_residue_of_zeta_zero
declarations.doc: In zeta language, the residue is `2 m(rho) I_W(rho+1/2)` with exact analytic multiplicity.

declarations.name: ccmRationalAdelicReducedNonunitalStrongHaarMellin_zero_at_zeta_zero
declarations.doc: Exact reduced restriction is annihilated at every non-pole zeta zero in the positive half-plane.

declarations.name: not_analyticAt_canonicalNegativeEulerSheet_of_right_half_zeta_zero
declarations.doc: A right-half zeta zero is never a removable singularity of the all-negative sheet.

declarations.name: dqpt_rate_at_zeta_zero
declarations.doc: Case 1 in the `ζ`-form** (valid off the line `Re s = 1`, in particular in the open critical strip): at a zeta zero the rate is `β ln 2`.

declarations.name: exists_low_height_zeta_zero_free
declarations.doc: The low-height zero-free margin**: some `δ ∈ (0, 1/8]` has no zeta zeros in `{1 - δ ≤ Re s, |Im s| ≤ 9} ∖ {1}`.

declarations.name: canonicalNegativeEulerSheet_has_pole_at_right_half_zeta_zero
declarations.doc: Every zeta zero in the closed right critical half-strip is a genuine pole of the canonical negative sheet. Together with `canonicalNegativeEulerSheet_divisor_polarity`, this records exact multiplicity rather than merely nonremovability.

declarations.name: riemannZeta_zero_ne_one
declarations.doc: A zero of `ζ` is not the pole.**

declarations.name: offLineMoment_le_add_zetaZeroMoment
declarations.doc: Window comparison for the moment.**

declarations.name: xi_zero_iff_zeta_zero_of_mem_strip
declarations.doc: In the open strip, ξ and ζ share exactly their zeros.** For `0 < Re s < 1`, `ξ s = 0 ↔ ζ s = 0`: the factors `s(s−1)/2` and `Γℝ s` that relate `ξ` to `ζ` are non-vanishing there (`s ≠ 0`, `s ≠ 1`, and `Γℝ` zero-free), so the entire completed zeta and the raw Dirichlet series have the same strip ramification divisor — all of it off the archimedean and prime-local factors.

declarations.name: doubleRepetitionDuursmaZeta_zero_criticalCircle
declarations.doc: The first assembled code zeta block satisfies the binary code Riemann hypothesis.

declarations.name: not_differentiable_expZeta_zero
declarations.doc: The untwisted series is the zeta function, so it is not entire.

declarations.name: upperSpectralZetaZeroWindow
declarations.doc: The finite canonical spectral window restricted to upper-half-plane zeros.

declarations.name: riemannZeta_zero_im_ne_zero
declarations.doc: The functional-equation input.** A zeta zero in the open critical strip is not real.

declarations.name: neg_logDeriv_zeta_zero_residue
declarations.doc: The residue of `-ζ'/ζ` at a zeta zero `ρ ≠ 1` is `-m(ρ)`**, where `m(ρ) ≥ 1` is the analytic multiplicity of the zero: `(s-ρ)·(-ζ'/ζ)(s) → -m`. Obtained by factoring `ζ = (z-ρ)^m·g` near `ρ` (`g` analytic, `g(ρ) ≠ 0`, from the removable/order structure of the analytic `ζ` on the connected set `{1}ᶜ`, using that `ζ` is not identically zero since `ζ(2) ≠ 0`) and applying `logDeriv_residue_of_factorization`. This turns each off-critical zeta zero into a pole of the prime–polar continuation with residue proportional to its multiplicity.

declarations.name: riemannZeta_zero_re_le_of_xiZeroHalfPlaneBound
declarations.doc: A zeta zero with nonzero ordinate obeys every supplied Xi half-plane bound.

declarations.name: hasSum_hasseRow_eq_zero_of_zetaZero
declarations.doc: (PFM.11).** Every nontrivial zeta zero gives an unconditional vanishing relation between the Hasse rows.

declarations.name: eventually_mem_spectralZetaZeroRadialWindow_selected
declarations.doc: Every fixed nontrivial zeta zero eventually belongs to the selected expanding radial windows.

declarations.name: exists_xiDivisorSupport_of_criticalMellin_regularizedZeta_zero
declarations.doc: Every regularized-zeta zero in the natural half-plane comes from the Xi divisor.

declarations.name: countable_zetaZeroHeights
declarations.doc: The heights of zeros of `ζ` in the strip `[1/2, 15/2] × [20, ∞)` form a countable set.

declarations.name: exists_zetaZeroDensity_scale_le_of_mollified_meanSquare
declarations.doc: Zero density at scale `Δ` from the mollified first moment.**

declarations.name: eventually_exists_riemannZeta_zero_titchmarsh
declarations.doc: Titchmarsh, Theorem 9.12, with an explicit absolute constant: every sufficiently high ordinate is within `1000 / log log log T` of the ordinate of a Riemann-zeta zero.

declarations.name: tendsto_mul_completedRiemannZeta_zero
declarations.doc: The completed zeta has a simple pole at `0` with residue `-1`: `s · Λ(s) → -1` as `s → 0` off the pole.

declarations.name: riemannZeta_zero_of_centred
declarations.doc: `ζ(0) = -1/2`, recovered from the additive side: the constant `-1/2 = -B₁` is the value of the centred sawtooth representation at `s = 0`.

declarations.name: two_le_norm_globalInertiaDefect_sub_of_zetaZero
declarations.doc: No compact repair of a zeta zero.** At a strict-right zero of zeta the global inertia defect stays at essential distance two from the compact operators.

declarations.name: criticalChebyshevBoostCurrent_residue_of_riemannZeta_zero
declarations.doc: C51 quantized source residue.** At every zeta zero `rho`, the Chebyshev boost current has residue `-(rho-1/2)m`, where `m>=1` is the zero multiplicity of the entire residue unit.

declarations.name: sum_spectralLowerZetaZeroWindow_eq_upper_conjugatePartner
declarations.doc: Reflection bijects the upper spectral part of a nonnegative symmetric window with its lower part, for an arbitrary additive summand.

declarations.name: not_summable_linear_proKummerTerm_of_zetaZero
declarations.doc: The contour form at a zeta zero.** A strict-right zero of zeta has divergent linear pro-Kummer action, so no capacity at or above the linear scale can be finite there.

declarations.name: exists_riemannZeta_zero_not_fzzCigarParityKreinEigenline_above
declarations.doc: Cofinal divisor escape.** Above every height there is an actual nontrivial zeta zero whose dyadic Mellin character misses the positive-imaginary literal source eigenline at every positive physical scale.

declarations.name: exists_zetaZero_re_gt_half_of_not_riemannHypothesis
declarations.doc: Where a counterexample lives.** Failure of the Riemann hypothesis produces a genuine zero of `ζ` strictly inside the right half of the critical strip.

declarations.name: exists_riemannZeta_zero_not_fzzCigarParityKreinEigenpair_above
declarations.doc: Full-pair cofinal divisor escape.** Above every height there is an actual nontrivial zeta zero whose dyadic Mellin character misses both literal source Krein eigenlines at every positive physical scale.

declarations.name: not_isIndFormed_chargeHistory_of_zetaZero
declarations.doc: The functional equation cannot repair the fracture.** At a strict-right zero of zeta the local history is not ind-formed, whatever multiplicity-preserving transport is applied.

declarations.name: spectralZetaZeroWindow_card_eq_critical_add_two_mul_upper
declarations.doc: A nonnegative symmetric spectral zero window consists of its critical-line part together with equally large upper and lower parts.

declarations.name: exists_marcinkiewicz_null_sequence_of_zetaZero
declarations.doc: The explicit nonclosability witness.** A zero of `ζ` in the right strip supplies a sequence of prime tails vanishing in the logarithmic Marcinkiewicz seminorm on which the residue functional has the constant nonzero value `-m`.

declarations.name: one_le_sq_mul_fermiLogVariance_of_zetaZero
declarations.doc: (PFM.14).** At a nontrivial zeta zero the logarithmic variance of the observer law is at least the inverse square of the ordinate; equivalently the pure-state quantum Fisher information of the induced phase orbit is at least `4 τ⁻²`.

declarations.name: exists_riemannZeta_line_zero_of_hardySEM_certified_sign_bracket
declarations.doc: Finite symmetrized-EM certificate for an actual critical-line zeta zero.** Two finite real approximant values of opposite sign, each clearing the explicit pointwise error budget, force a genuine zeta zero between their heights.

declarations.name: adjoinedFactor_eq_zero

declarations.name: riemannZeta_line_eq_zero_iff_hardyZ
declarations.doc: Exact zeta-zero/Hardy-Z interface.**

declarations.name: tendsto_regGerm_slope
declarations.doc: `(11c)`.** At a zeta zero in the strip the regularized germ has slope `i ζ(s-1) ≠ 0`.

declarations.name: dyadicMFreeZetaSubproduct_eq_zero

declarations.name: tendsto_chronologicalCrossPrefix_eulerDeletion_domain
declarations.doc: The ordered cross level exists on this entire domain, without a zeta-zero assumption.

declarations.name: iteratedDeriv_faceFunction
declarations.doc: The leading face jet.** At a zeta zero of order `d` the `d`-th face jet is the zeta jet times the face unit.

declarations.name: pairedEtaTopPrefixFiniteCenteredArithmeticAtom
declarations.doc: The arithmetic endpoint atom for the top-prefix centered moment at one genuine nontrivial zeta zero.

declarations.name: coPoissonCancelledSource_eq_normal_of_multiplier_eq_zero
declarations.doc: On a completed-zeta zero fibre, the cancelled source is purely normal.

declarations.name: source_schedule_boundary
declarations.doc: All cofinal schedules staying above one positive relative cutoff preserve the same source-selected strict/inclusive collision charge at a hypothetical right-half zeta zero.

declarations.name: zeta23_zerosIn_zero_toFinset_eq_stripFinsetPos
declarations.doc: Zeta23's nontrivial zeta-zero window `(0,T]` is exactly this project's finite completed-Xi window.

declarations.name: dyadicSharpPrimeCancelledSource_eq_mul_continuedSource
declarations.doc: Away from a shifted zeta zero, cancellation is literal multiplication of the meromorphic continued source by the pole-filled zeta.

declarations.name: eulerDeletionDirichletSum_eq_zero_of_riemannZeta_eq_zero
declarations.doc: Every positive-half-plane zeta zero closes every Euler-deletion path at level one.

declarations.name: primeObservable_no_limit
declarations.doc: Off-critical detection.** A zeta zero `ρ` with `Re ρ > 1/2` makes the observable have a genuine singularity at `s = ρ + ½`: it tends to no finite limit there.

declarations.name: visibleCoprimeZetaKernel
declarations.doc: Holomorphically continued primitive-coprime zeta symbol.

declarations.name: mellin_arithmeticSum_eq_zero_of_zeta_eq_zero
declarations.doc: Equation (6).** The Mellin transform of the arithmetic summation vector vanishes at every nontrivial zeta zero, including any hypothetical off-line zero.

declarations.name: cglPrincipalLZero_riemannZeta_eq_zero
declarations.doc: A principal Dirichlet `L`-zero in the critical strip is a Riemann-zeta zero. The finite Euler correction cannot vanish in the positive half-plane.

declarations.name: windowObservable_no_limit
declarations.doc: General off-critical detection.** For any window multiplier `W` continuous and nonzero at `ρ+½`, a zeta zero `ρ` with `Re ρ > ½` makes `windowObservable W` have a genuine singularity at `s = ρ+½`.

declarations.name: riemannZeta_eq_zero_iff_echoLadder
declarations.doc: The single-missing-rung law.** In the open critical strip a zeta zero is exactly the disappearance of the zeroth rung of the echo ladder, every later rung remaining present.

declarations.name: tendsto_boundaryChart_escape
declarations.doc: `(24)`: the divisor charge escapes every compact boundary chart.** In the boundary coordinate `z = L(s-1)` the branch point attached to a zeta zero `ρ ≠ 1` runs off to infinity at speed `log N`.

declarations.name: deriv_riemannZeta_line_eq_zero_iff_deriv_hardyZ_of_zero
declarations.doc: The height derivative of critical-line zeta vanishes at a zeta zero exactly when the real Hardy-Z derivative vanishes there.

declarations.name: not_mem_closedSpan_of_continuous_evaluation
declarations.doc: If a continuous evaluation kills all approximants but not the target, the target is not in their closed span. This is the direct closure obstruction used at a hypothetical zeta zero.

declarations.name: exists_terminalHardyPhase_finiteCertificateZeroLaw
declarations.doc: Terminal phase finite-certificate law.** Ordered terminal Hardy phase levels have unique ordered height representatives, and every certified finite sign bracket at those representatives forces a critical-line zeta zero.

declarations.name: tendsto_unitRieszCoefficientResidue
declarations.doc: Equation (17).** The continued coefficient transform keeps a genuine pole at every nontrivial zeta zero, with residue `3 m / (2 rho (rho + 1/2))`: the probability multiplier vanishes to first order there, but the logarithmic-derivative pole survives.

declarations.name: analyticOrderAt_coPoissonCancelledSource_eq_pred_of_mellin_ne_zero
declarations.doc: At every uncensored completed-zeta zero, the co-Poisson cancelled source loses exactly one vanishing order. This retains the full zero multiplicity without assuming simplicity.

declarations.name: primeGradeMonodromy_zero_residue
declarations.doc: (3)–(4) The grade-one prime monodromy at a strip zero.** At every zeta zero to the right of the critical line the continued grade-one source has residue exactly minus the multiplicity: the higher prime-power grades are holomorphic there.

declarations.name: jetSymbol_vanishing_of_analyticOrder
declarations.doc: The Jordan multiplier hierarchy.** At a zeta zero of multiplicity `m` the symbol of the `k`-th lift vanishes exactly for `k < m`, so the mode annihilated by every lower lift is exposed by the `m`-th one.

declarations.name: half_le_norm_detPolyC_of_box
declarations.doc: Detection at every zero of the box, from two separated inequalities.** Combining the monotone transfer with the explicit criterion: under the two `σ`-level bounds, every zeta zero with `re ρ ≥ σ` and `T ≤ ‖ρ − 1‖`, `‖ρ‖ ≤ 2T` gives a detecting value.

declarations.name: ccmBulkCharacter_nonzero_forces_tentPoleUniversality
declarations.doc: CCM bulk-character tent-pole detection universality law.** If a nonconstant physical aperture character lands on a zeta zero and its edge-free prime channel is nonzero, the corresponding moving-tent observable has no finite limit at that shifted zero.

declarations.name: analyticOrderAt_riemannZeta_one_sub
declarations.doc: The order of `ζ` at a strip zero is symmetric under the functional equation.**

declarations.name: bdTarget_dist_floor
declarations.doc: The quantitative floor at a point of the right half-plane.** Every element of the carrier annihilated by the detector at `ρ` stays at distance at least `√(2Re ρ − 1)/|ρ|` from the target. No property of `ρ` beyond `½ < Re ρ` is used: the zeta zero enters only through `bdTarget_dist_floor_of_mem_closedSpan`, which identifies a set of annihilated vectors.

declarations.name: PcalObservable_no_limit_of_amplitude_ne
declarations.doc: Tent genuine pole from a nonvanishing amplitude.** For a nontrivial zeta zero `ρ` (`ρ ≠ 1`, `Re ρ > 0`, `ρ ≠ ½`) with `A_L(ρ-½) ≠ 0`, the tent observable `PcalObservable L` has no finite limit at `s = ρ + ½` — a genuine pole. The polar and correction terms are continuous there (the correction via the widened `HL` holomorphy), so the pole is inherited entirely from the prime channel (`windowObservable_no_limit`).

declarations.name: logDeriv_riemannZeta_add_reflect_of_one_lt_re
declarations.doc: Reflection formula in the half-plane of absolute convergence.** Both nonvanishing hypotheses are discharged there: `ζ(s) ≠ 0` classically for `Re s > 1`, and `ζ(1-s) ≠ 0` because reflection preserves the zeta zero locus off the two pole ladders. What remains is the arithmetic condition that `1 - s` avoid the trivial zeros, i.e. that `s` not be an odd integer `1, 3, 5, …`.

declarations.name: offcritical_residue
declarations.doc: Off-critical residue / divisor tomography** (§5, eqs. 24–25). Each zeta zero `ρ` with `Re ρ > 1/2` (`ρ ≠ 1`) produces a genuine simple pole of the prime term at `s = ρ + ½`, with residue `2·m(ρ)·A_L(ρ-½)²` — nonzero because `m(ρ) ≥ 1` and the rectangular amplitude does not vanish in the open right half-plane (`rectangularWindowAmplitude_ne_zero`). So no off-critical pole cancels, and the residue reads off the exact analytic multiplicity `m(ρ)`.

declarations.name: artin_stark_simpleZero_order_classifier
declarations.doc: Stark simple-zero order classification.** Let `degree i` be positive character degrees and `order i` the integer orders of corresponding Artin L-functions at a fixed point. If the Artin--Takagi weighted order is `1` and Foote--Murty square norm is at most `1`, then exactly one component has degree and order both `1`; all other orders vanish. In particular, no component has a pole. This is dependency-closed arithmetic core of literature's simple Dedekind-zeta-zero case.

declarations.name: polarPrimeObservable_no_limit
declarations.doc: General genuine pole of the renormalized observable.** At a zeta zero `ρ ≠ 1`, if the window `W` is continuous with `W(ρ+½) ≠ 0`, then `polarPrimeObservable κ W` has no finite limit at `s = ρ+½`: the polar counterterm `κ·ζ(s-½)` is continuous there (`ρ ≠ 1`), so the prime channel's simple pole survives. This closed meromorphic form carries no error term, so the statement holds on the whole plane with no strip restriction — the detection primitive for two-width divisor recovery.

declarations.name: HL_differentiableOn_gt_half
declarations.doc: Holomorphy of `H_L` on the maximal strip `{Re s > ½} ∖ {1}`.** The weighted error series `∑_k (Λ(k)/√k)·E_{k,L}(s)` converges absolutely and locally uniformly wherever the dominating von Mangoldt series `∑ Λ(k) k^{-σ-½}` converges, i.e. `σ > ½` — the full half-plane `Re s > ½`, not just the Euler region `Re s > 1`. The single point `s = 1` is removed because the leading integral identity `∫ g_s = A_L(s-1)²` (hence `E_kL_bound_explicit`) is proved off the amplitude's removable singularity at `s = 1`; the ball around each `s₀ ≠ 1` is shrunk to avoid it. This is the strip in which every nontrivial-zeta-zero pole `s = ρ + ½` (including the critical-line heights `s = 1 + iγ`, `γ ≠ 0`) lives.
